scope: Read-only current dirty website integration and exact original Truss a9048c83 delivery. Original provider source and owner receipts inspected; separate forthcoming feed/cancellation/retention components excluded. No source edits.
conclusions: Actual public API loading creates four original objects. Original Weft selection and UMF manifest select three into full-first [2,1] batches. Real original Truss execution changes exactly three names and increments their versions once; the fourth row remains unchanged.

Strict atomic execute:n admission retains exact job/batch/fence before first dispatch. Competing host pages cannot reserve a batch twice; existing input routes only to original recoverBatch. Quota/abort/non-strict admission refuses before dispatch.

Dropped actual first committed batch acknowledgement recovers exact full item results and receipt after reopen. Fresh authoritative job state chooses the second batch, and the completed job has a contiguous prefix of two batches. Terminal replay leaves exact result and data unchanged.

Independent host interruption after committed intent but before engine admission produces actual indeterminate recovery; it never redispatches execution, authorizes a new claim, changes object data/versions or advances the committed prefix. Forced UI dispatch cannot bypass the retained intent.

Recovered claim supplies correlation for an original first execute only when no prior host execute intent exists. Actual current owner/action/read grant, original fence/lease and native admission remain authoritative. Host receipt data creates no authority.

All BatchOutcome and full ItemResult fields pass through worker/page/journal without narrowing. Independent real no-op batches preserve every value/version, return noOp with empty changes, carry zero business journal entries and replay exact terminal receipts; native WebCrypto verifies receipt digests.
The declared unsupported job-review branch now fails closed without a UI exception while retaining its full visible result.
Exact source/static asset cohort and GitHub Pages base-path behavior are retained. No external or write HTTP requests occur. Original native person/service cohort remains distinct.

ownerEvidenceScope.noOpStaleGuardAndAtomicRollback: Original a9048c83 receipt and seven artifact digests verified. publicationGate.reason: Independent pinned verify --all reports the changed compiler HTML STALE, with 16 other claims VALID. Human 1Password signing remains pending; reviewer did not access signing keys or publish.

limitations: This establishes the reviewed local browser required-String/rootless fixed Products E2E slice, not complete local-bulk/1 or native CONTRACT-904 support.
Public feed, cancellation, retirement/retention, arbitrary restore/crash qualification, wider scalar/value/relationship support and native human/service equivalence remain outside this checkpoint.

The native 60-second claim lease may refuse first admission after expiry; automatic lease renewal/restart and general liveness are not qualified. Existing execute intent never becomes fresh-dispatch authority.
Browser storage eviction, arbitrary corruption and sustained resource/deadline guarantees are not established by these bounded runs.
No deployment or publication claim is made while the HTML attestation is stale.
